authority_hierarchy.rule: Key candidates are pending user acceptance and may control motion only until accepted.

identity_lock.silhouette: Approved large rounded head, compact navy dress, sturdy legs, canonical viewer-right satchel and one rabbit.
identity_lock.proportions: Local head widths must remain within four pixels after complete-drawing normalization; crouch changes joint angles and root height, not identity scale.
identity_lock.face_and_markings: Muted blue-gray eyes, matte ash-beige bob and broad rounded face remain fixed.
identity_lock.costume: Navy beret and dress, cream collar and lace, orange ribbon, three buttons, canonical strap, satchel, rabbit, socks and Mary Jane shoes remain topologically intact.
identity_lock.rendering: Fine dark outlines, restrained warm cel shading, subdued hair highlights, smooth navy fabric and fixed front orthographic camera.

action_contract.intent: Sparse landing keys descend, contact, compress, stabilize and recover on an invisible horizontal edge.
action_contract.allowed_motion: Vertical root travel, lower-body impact flexion, restrained balance gesture, eyelids and connected secondary motion.
action_contract.forbidden_changes: No identity, scale, topology, palette, material or camera drift; no platform artwork; no interpolation or part compositing.

contact_ledger.contact_points: none at K00; both soles from K03 onward

threshold_notes.baseline_lock: Disabled for airborne descent and legitimate vertical landing compression.
threshold_notes.max_area_drift: Sparse keys include a deeply flexed but user-reviewable compression family; local head and material checks remain mandatory.
threshold_notes.adjacent_diff: These are sparse semantic keys, not final adjacent runtime frames.
threshold_notes.max_centroid_acceleration_px: The K06 compression and K10 stabilized-rise poses bracket a deliberately large recovery interval that will be subdivided midpoint-first with four independently drawn direct frames. The final sequence does not inherit this sparse-key allowance.
